section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a repeated measures ANOVA examining within-group mean differences in body size ratings across four conditions: participants' current body size, personal ideal, ethnic group ideal, and typical ethnic female peer body size (adjusted for BMI). Bonferroni-corrected post-hoc tests revealed that participants rated their actual body size as significantly larger than their personal ideal and ethnic group ideal, but smaller than their ethnic female peers. The personal ideal was rated as significantly smaller than both the ethnic group ideal and typical peer body size.
